messages:
anya: Quick capture from today's architecture huddle — proposing a long-lived refactor called 'edge-skein' to split routing hotpath from enrichment and make ownership explicit. High-level rationale and checkpoints below.

matt: name? :) what's the main win vs the current proxy split we've debated before?

anya: Focus: reduce tail latency on token generation by removing enrichment stalls from the hotpath. Secondary: clear ownership of KV cache and session metadata to accelerate future runtime optimizations.

meera: migration risks? key collisions and ordering are my top two. We should define reconciliation and detection early.

sam: Implementation sketch: small edge-skein binary (stateless routing + affinity) -> dedicated per-pop KV shards for cache -> enrichment moves to async workers. Start with read-only routing mirror, then opt-in canary, dual-write with reconciliation, then cutover.

mikel: Ops constraints: need per-tenant rollback, canary cluster, and a one-page runbook for rollback thresholds. Recommend auto rollback on p99 +25% or error-rate jump >0.5% sustained 5m.

anya: Proposed checkpoints: 1) mirror-only deploy behind flag; 2) 5% opt-in canary (per-tenant flags); 3) dual-write session metadata + reconciliation job; 4) widen to non-SLA tenants; 5) deprecate old proxy after 2w steady-state.

matt: Metrics for gates: p50/p95/p99 latency, KV miss ratio, enrichment lag, per-tenant cost delta. Also instrument trace tags: "edge-skein.phase" and "edge-skein.owner".

meera: For reconciliation: ship a smoke checker that replays a minute of production traffic and compares prefix keys and ordering. Surface diffs >0.05% to oncall.

sam: Flag payload example in rollout service (stringified): {"flags":"edge_skein.enabled=false, edge_skein.canary=[\"alpha\"]"}. We'll keep flags per-tenant and per-pop.

mikel: I'll provision a canary pop and draft the runbook. Add synthetic load to the dashboard to detect batching regressions.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary pipeline queued: edge-skein/canary/1767009999. CI: https://ci.internal/edge-skein/canary/1767009999

anya: Action items: Sam - initial shim PR for mirror mode; Meera - replay harness + reconciliation checker; Matt - canary dashboard + synthetic profile; Mikel - runbook + alerts. I'll follow up with an RFC follow-up doc with sprint estimates and owners.

matt: :thumbsup: keep surface minimal initially (no enrichment extraction in phase 1).

meera: Agreed. We'll only move routing in phases A/B. Enrichment extraction later when reconciliation is rock-solid.

anya: Thanks everyone. Will post the RFC follow-up and link the canary when ready.
